newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia minister leaves for Peru to help envoy.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia minister leaves for Peru to help envoy.

text.p: Malaysian Foreign Minister Abdullah Badawi left for Lima on Wednesday to intensify efforts to secure the release of Kuala Lumpur's ambassador to Peru who is among hostages held in the besieged Japanese embassy residence.
A statement from Malaysia's foreign ministry said Abdullah Badawi left on a "special mission" on the instruction of Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.

"Arrangements have been made for Abdullah to call on Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori, and other Peruvian ministers, to hold discussions on the current hostage crisis and in particular to further intensify the efforts to secure the safe and early release of Ambassador Ahmad Mokhtar," the statement said.
